entries.title: Startup Raises Series B To Build Faster Build Systems
entries.summary:
A build-tooling startup announced a $40 million Series B on Thursday, saying it would use the money to expand its compiler-caching product beyond its current handful of enterprise customers into a broader self-serve offering. The round was led by a growth-stage fund that has previously backed several developer-tooling companies, with participation from two existing seed investors. The company said revenue had roughly tripled over the past year, driven mostly by teams migrating off slower incumbent build systems, and that it planned to double headcount by the end of next year, with most of the new hires going into a distributed-systems team focused on cache invalidation correctness rather than sales.

entries.title: Regional Trade Talks Resume After Two-Week Pause
entries.summary: Officials from both delegations returned to the table on Wednesday after a two-week pause driven by a disagreement over agricultural tariffs, with negotiators from both sides describing the mood as cautiously constructive heading into a final scheduled round of talks next month, though neither side would commit to a specific date for a signed agreement given how many sticking points on quota levels and dispute-resolution mechanisms remain unresolved between the two blocs.
